questions.question: How well does this listing address pet owners protecting their sofa from dogs or cats?
questions.label: Directly Addresses
matchingBullets: Bullet 2: 'ideal for both children and pets' → explicitly mentions pet use case
Bullet 3: 'anti-slip silicone particles... protects your sofa from dirt and scratches' → directly addresses pet damage concerns (claws, dirt)
Bullet 1: 'high-quality velvet, plush sofa cover... enhancing coziness' → plush material is soft but could show wear from pets

questions.question: How well does this listing address furniture refresh / home decoration on a budget?
questions.label: Implicitly Addresses
matchingBullets: Bullet 1: 'Premium Material... cloud-like soft and comfortable feel, enhancing the coziness of your living space' → mentions 'living space' upgrade but doesn't explicitly say 'budget-friendly alternative to buying new furniture'
Bullet 2: 'Elegant Design... perfect for loveseat, L-shaped sofas, and recliner' → mentions design but doesn't connect to 'makeover' or 'refresh' language that budget decorators search for
questions.intentEnhancement: Bullet 1 could explicitly position this as a sofa transformation solution: 'Instant sofa upgrade without replacing furniture — premium velvet cover transforms your existing sofa at a fraction of the cost of new furniture.'

questions.question: How well does this listing address parents needing easy-clean furniture protection?
questions.label: Implicitly Addresses
matchingBullets: Bullet 4: 'machine washing (do not bleach)... frees your hands from household chores' → mentions washing but doesn't explicitly connect to parent scenarios (spills, accidents, sticky hands)
Bullet 2: 'ideal for both children and pets' → mentions children but doesn't expand on WHY (spill protection, easy cleanup after messy activities)
questions.intentEnhancement: Bullet 4 should lead with the parent use case: 'Perfect for families — spilled drinks, sticky fingers, and daily mess wipe clean easily. Just toss in the washing machine (no bleach) for a fresh start.'

gaps: Budget decoration angle not fully leveraged — no 'sofa transformation' positioning
Parent use case (spills, accidents) mentioned but not expanded with specific scenarios
All-season claim (Bullet 3 'year-round') has no thermal data to support — remove or qualify
recommendations: Rewrite Bullet 1 to include 'sofa makeover / transformation' framing for budget decorators
Expand Bullet 4 to explicitly name parent scenarios (spills, sticky hands, potty training) while keeping washing instructions
Remove or soften 'year-round' claim in Bullet 3 — no thermal rating provided
